theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible leader with above-median durability (0.67 vs the 0.5-ish centre of eligible themes) and broad participation (breadth 0.769), and it clears the absolute-trend gate, which is the one validated drawdown/vol-control leg in this market. The lean is a staying-power expression of the gate plus coherent breadth, not a claim that rank 1 predicts return.
theses.dissent: Banks is a mean-reversion-prone cyclical in a policy-sensitive Hong Kong tape; its leadership is itself partly a flight-to-known-names by a narrow market, and if it breaks below its own trend gate the only validated reason to hold it disappears.
